node.title: Re^3: search for 'cat' not followed by 'dog'
node.author: stevieb
node.doctext: Old habit that I write in a non-capture when I'm doing grouping. In this case, after some *quick* testing, I realize that the negative lookahead doesn't appear to capture by default. In fact, even with benchmarking, the non-cap is effectively no more efficient than leaving it out.
